entries.en: Please don't touch anything.
I'm trying to work here.
You're in my light.
You're disturbing the crime scene. Could you find someplace else to be?
I acquiesced to your demands. Do not press me for more. There are limits.
We both gained from our arrangement. Why don't you go look for Lady Benezia?
You will excuse me if I don't stand up.
Yes, isn't everything?
Businesses come here to avoid the second-guessing of galactic law.
Just so we understand each other.
I will not allow you to harass our clients. This world is private property.
I trust you can show yourself out.
Don't be ridiculous. Do you think a for-profit company would take no precautions against loss of life and material?
Project leads have the final say here. Not meddlesome politicians.
Nevertheless, I have a responsibility to keep you away from them. Spectres are not encumbered by a need for due process.
Spectre. Have you, by any chance, acquired Mr. Qui'in's so-called "evidence?"
Please do not weary me with more talk. Noveria does not run itself.
I presume you are here to present me with Opold's package?
I am in the middle of nine things, all of them annoying. What do you want now?
I'll be leaving now.
Are you telling me you have no safety protocols?
And I represent the "second-guessing of galactic law."
I'm not here to investigate your tenants.
I've acquired Qui'in's evidence of your misconduct. Let's talk.
Your secretary is a plant for the Executive Board. Internal Affairs, she said.
Opold wants me to smuggle a package through security.
I'm leaving.
I'm conducting an investigation. It's a matter of galactic security.
We are back in contact with Peak 15. They say you destroyed the hot lab facility and killed Lady Benezia.
I need more than your word to act on that. Bring me whatever he's smuggling and I'll act accordingly.
I am no weapons expert, but it seems to me that this is a rather advanced device. Certainly contraband.
It would have been unfortunate if this had reached its buyer.
I am willing to give you 200 credits and a pass to leave Hanshan. Not without an understanding between us, of course.
You can only go to Peak 15 to speak to Lady Benezia. If you cause trouble, or if the staff asks you to leave, you will be thrown offworld.
I understand your meaning perfectly. I will give you an additional 400 credits, for a total of 600.
If there is nothing else, I would like to go back to work.
Of course. That makes perfect sense. I wouldn't know what to do with it anyway. It would be best if you kept it.
Er, oh, uh, of course.
How interesting. There is a limited number of people who could provide one. I will increase the reward to 600 credits.
That is not the response I anticipated from a Spectre. I may have underestimated you.
You are shrewd to use this as leverage. If it is a serious infraction, I will give you a pass.
I would compensate you. The precise amount in credits depends on the severity of Opold's crime.
No one here is fond of trials. They make shareholders nervous.
More likely we would simply let him go. Of course, he would be blacklisted by the companies here.
I appreciate your report.
She arrived a few days ago, accompanied by a personal escort and some cargo. She is up at Peak 15.
If I knew, I wouldn't be at liberty to say. She came here as Agent Saren's executor.
She is here on business for Binary Helix. There were issues at Peak 15 that required Saren's attention.
Excuse me, his what?
Executor. Saren is a major shareholder in Binary Helix. Lady Benezia is authorized to act in his name.
His what?
Excuse me, his what?
Excuse me, his what?
Excuse me, his what?
Large, heavy, and sealed. It passed weapons screening. Beyond that it is not our concern.
I'm afraid that you cannot. Peak 15 is a private facility in the Skadi Mountains.
Regardless, there is a blizzard in the area. Shuttles are grounded, and surface access has been cut off.
Cut off, I said. The roads are not suitable for travel. Don't make an issue of this, Shepard.
The phrase is self-explanatory. Bodyguards attending to the safety of her person. Mainly asari commandos.
Commandos? You didn't think that odd?
They followed all our regulations. I had no reason to forbid Lady Benezia from taking them.
You let asari who can kill you with their brains run around, but give us flak about guns?
Commandos? You didn't think that was weird?
Commandos? Odd that you shouldn't mind their presence.
And you didn't think that odd?
Every minute of my time you waste costs the company 12 credits. I will keep a running tally.
Good. I received a dozen urgent messages while you dithered about.
I believe I explained this already, did I not?
Agent Saren? One of your Spectre compatriots?
It's possible, given his interests. What our clients do in their labs is their business.
An area of severe weather has cut off contact. Things will return to normal in a few days.
I have placed Lorik Qui'in, the manager of the Hanshan office, under internal review. I cannot comment further at this time.
You need my help to leave this port. I am curious why you would renege on our agreement.
That should have been my decision.
I consider this matter closed. Was there anything else you wanted?
There is a limited number of people who could help you. I must consult my records.
Your "likes" are no concern of mine. I gave you the opportunity to earn my gratitude.
I will not insult you by demanding the buyer's identity. I will alert the guards to be on the lookout.
So long as contraband is not brought into Noveria, I do not object.
Then why are you bothering me?
Eh-- That is good to know. Would you mind stepping outside? I'm afraid I will have to let Ms. Parasini go. It can't wait.
Ms. Parasini? Would you come in here for a moment?
Of course, Mr. Anoleis.
Your mind has not been fully on your duty to me.
I don't understand, sir.
I'm not losing this job.
Anoleis, if I don't report in, the Board will figure it out! Put the weapon d--
I said, I'm not losing this job!
Yes, I have it with me.
I changed my mind and gave it to him.
Here's the package. Proof enough?
All part of the job.
Opold's buyer is not going to be happy when he hears this. I can keep an eye on him, if you sweeten the reward.
You know, that's a dangerous weapon. It shouldn't be left unsecured. I should impound it.
If this incident was reported, it would be bad for business. But I could arrange for my report to headquarters to be "overlooked."
Of course. But I'll keep that mod. It's military hardware. I can't leave it in the hands of a civilian.
I already have a pass.
How thankful are you?
It's not yours yet. Make it worth my time.
Not so fast. In exchange, I want garage access.
What will you do for me in return?
So you'll arrest him?
I'll look into it and get back to you.
I've heard an asari Matriarch is here. Benezia?
What brought her out here?
What did you mean by "personal escort?"
What can you tell me about her cargo?
I'd like to see her immediately.
Surface access, you say?
What do you mean "personal escort?"
Back to my other questions.
I have no more questions at this time.
Do you do business with Saren?
Is Binary Helix developing weapons for him?
Is there some problem on Peak 15?
Why is Synthetic Insights closed?
Opold was smuggling bobble-head geisha dolls. It wasn't worth your time.
Not right now.
Alternate means out of Hanshan were available.
I don't like your attitude, Mr. Anoleis.
I got a better deal from the intended buyer.
I delivered the package to its intended buyer.
I've decided to keep it myself.
I don't have it yet.
I don't have it yet.
Mr. Qui'in contacted me. You gave him his evidence. Now he is blackmailing me, as well.
Have you reconsidered your ill-advised decision to withhold Qui'in's materials?
Indeed? Surely you can see his story is a lie, to cover his own crimes?
We certainly shall.
As a small item of note, Mr. Qui'in has hidden away certain records that would greatly aid my investigation.
If you happen to recover them, I would be in your debt. You understand me?
Mr. Qui'in's records would doubtless aid my own investigation against him.
I will soon enough. My security teams are seeing to the matter.
Will you turn it over to me, then?
Don't be foolish. I can have you deported and take it by force.
I will give you time to reconsider. Don't disappoint me. And don't cross me.
Mr. Qui'in is under criminal investigation. You cannot believe any fabrications he would spin in his defense.
What are you proposing, then? That question is not an admission of guilt.
And you would keep this supposed "evidence," I imagine.
You need a pass to enter our garage. As a gesture of goodwill, I will provide one. Noveria prizes its good relations with the Citadel.
I'm so glad you've decided to help us.
I'm so glad you've decided to help us.
Ah, we could have saved time by beating him into cooperation.
We couldn't do that!
Yes we could. You think he lifts anything heavier than stacks of hardcopy?
I would've arrested him. But we do need to get on with the mission.
You are letting him get away with this so we can continue our investigation? How shortsighted.
I trust you will attend to your own business now.
If this "evidence" proved an actual crime, I would be a fool not to accept your deal.
Lorik Qui'in wants me to break into his own office. He says you're corrupt.
We'll see what the truth is soon enough.
He asked me to recover certain records relating to you.
You have any proof of that?
From what I saw, Qui'in's allegations are true.
Calm down. I don't care about your petty crimes.
That's my plan. Goodbye, Mr. Anoleis.
Shut your piehole. Give me a pass to leave or the evidence goes to the Board.
Give me what I need to find the Matriarch, and I'll leave the evidence with you.
That will do fine.
A curious statement. Regardless, I am not concerned. Agent Saren will hold you to blame for her death, not I.
I would like to know exactly what happened. Off the record.
I am prepared to offer our standard 200-credit fee.
A great deal, I imagine. Very well. I will double the standard fee.
Do you think I am foolish enough to insult someone who is blackmailing me? I can double the standard fee, but no more.
No need to take umbrage. I will double the standard fee.
Yes, amusing. Be serious.
That's-- If what you say is true, the profits could be incalculable.
Biological weapons. Perhaps a hazmat team could recover some genetic material.
I appreciate your insight, Commander. If you will excuse me.
No matter. I am confident I can convince one of the survivors to talk.
Please close the door when you leave.
I am not holding you to blame for anything that occurred. Clearly, they failed to maintain control over an experiment.
I will escape from this arrangement. When I do, you had best steer clear of me.
No doubt you have more pressing demands on your time. As do I, to be frank.
I do not believe-- That is not your best option. I would like to make a proposal.
Give Mr. Qui'in's "evidence" to me. It is all lies. But it may help my investigation into his corruption.
Ultimately the courts will decide that. And I can afford quite a bit of justice.
I could easily arrange passage to Peak 15. Last I heard of her, she was going there.
I would also offer the Executive Board's standard compensation for private investigators.
We have a standard bonus we pay to private investigators. But you need more than that, do you not?
You need to speak with Lady Benezia. I can arrange access for you. If you give me this "evidence."
Excellent.
Here is a pass into our garage. I will wire the funds directly into your accounts.
I accept this deal. I still insist I am innocent. That Qui'in is the guilty one.
Yes, of course he is.
Yes, of course he is.
Of course he is.
That is a mistake. But it is the right of every sentient being to make mistakes.
How much would that be worth to you?
Do you know how much the Daily Galactic News would pay for this?
Oh, I see. You're insulting me. If you want the truth, stop wasting my time and make a real offer.
They were breeding rachni.
Seriously, rachni. They found a queen's egg.
I'm always serious. Maybe you didn't notice.
Let's say they were breeding monsters, and some of them escaped.
Life is full of little disappointments, Mr. Anoleis. This is one of yours.
Benezia didn't have full control of her own mind.
The staff recommended destroying the lab.
You get near a point, make it.
I'll need something from you in exchange.
No. Just reminding you I have them. Enjoy your day.
I have.
No, not yet.
No, not yet.
It's not my place to believe you or not. I'm turning it over to the Executive Board.
You're guilty as hell, and you're going down.
I'll consider it if you help me get to Matriarch Benezia.
And how would this generosity benefit me?
That sounds reasonable. You have a deal.
How about this? You help me get to Benezia, I don't turn you over to the Board. And I keep the evidence to ensure your good behavior.
I don't think so.
If it's fake, then you won't mind my turning it over to him.
Commander Shepard, I have issues I must deal with now. I would prefer not to be disturbed.
Be cautious, Spectre. You have no power over me.
Benezia was out of control.
What can you offer me?
Goodbye.
Yes.
No.
[LIE] No.
Here you are.
I gave it to him.
I gave it to the buyer.
I'm keeping it.
No.
[LIE] I don't have it.
[Lie] It was worthless.
I had other options.
I don't like you.
The buyer offered more.
Goodbye.
Lorik asked me for help.
I have Lorik's evidence.
Gianna is investigating you.
Opold asked me to smuggle.
Goodbye.
We'll see.
He has evidence.
Prove it.
No. You're guilty.
Explain it to the Board.
Then I'll give it to Qui'in.
We can reach an agreement.
No deals.
If you help me get to Benezia.
What do I get out of this?
I accept.
You'll do what I say.
No.
You'll do what I say.
Get me to Benezia.
Goodbye.
Here's the package.
I want garage access.
What's in it for me?
So you'll arrest him?
I'll return later.
My pleasure.
Let's discuss my reward.
What's it worth to you?
I earned more.
I'll keep the upgrade.
More money.
The upgrade is mine.
I have a pass.
That will do.
Matriarch Benezia
Saren
Peak 15 problems
Synthetic Insights
Why is she here?
What sort of cargo?
I need to see her.
Define "personal escort."
Another topic.
Define "personal escort."
So we drive.
Goodbye.
Is he developing weapons here?
I'm on a mission.
Isn't lack of oversight risky?
You think I'm a threat.
I'm looking for someone.
Goodbye.
I was told to destroy the lab.
So what?
What's it worth to you?
Rachni.
Biological weapons.
I can't tell you.
The news would offer more.
Don't insult me.
I am.
Fine, don't believe me.
Yeah, of course he is.
Of course he is.
That's it? Forget it.
Very well. I will remain at your disposal.
A pleasure, Commander.
This greeting is a courtesy. I will only cooperate as required by the Executive Board.
Read much history?
Read much history?
Read much history?
I'll give it to Qui'in.
Gianna is investigating you.
He is a major investor in Binary Helix corporation, which is one of Noveria's backers.
This discussion is at an end. Good day.
I have no time to entertain spaceborn vagabonds.
With any transient population. Unreliable consumer bases. Tax-dodgers, probably.
I had no idea we were so troubling to your bottom line.
I have no time to entertain colonial rubes.
No appreciation for economics. Protectionists and communists, all of them.
I have no time to entertain refugees from that urban blight called Earth.
Believe me, that is foremost in my mind.
Only a fool enters negotiation without knowledge of the other party's tendencies.
You better show some respect.
My homeworld is clean. Poverty is non-existent. If you take some perverse pride in that overheated, acid-washed slum, that is your business.
You have a problem with spacers?
You have a problem with colonials?
I'm here as a Spectre, not a human. Keep that in mind.
I see you looked up my service record.
Funny thing about humans. We're pretty loyal to our homeworld.
I won't take up much of your time.
"Vagabonds?"
"Rubes?"
I'm a Spectre.
You've read my file.
Watch your mouth.
I'll be brief.
Forget him, Commander. If he won't play ball, I'm sure someone else here will.
Forget him, Commander. If he won't help us, I'm sure someone else here will.
Let him be stubborn, Shepard. I'm sure someone else here is willing to help us.
Forget him, Commander. If he won't play ball, I'm sure someone else here will.
Shepard. I am sure that there are other people here who could help us.
I have the package Opold wanted me to smuggle.
Biological weapons.
Here's Opold's package.
We have no business left between us.
Why not fly off and damage someone else's world?
Thank you for your assistance, Mr. Anoleis.
It's a shame you didn't cooperate in the first place.
Rachni.
Rachni.
Rachni.
Thanks.
About time.
Mr. Anoleis, all I care about is finding Benezia. Is that something you can help me with?
I don't want to upset you by showing you this evidence. Mr. Anoleis. It's fairly incriminating.
I'm not here to arrest you.
I'll hold onto it.
Oh, you're guilty.
That would be dishonest.
Gianna is investigating you.
What do you propose?
Glad to help.
I've earned a reward.
You owe me.
Mother of-- Corporal, secure the area. Keep everyone out of here. Now!
Yes, ma'am!
What happened here, Commander Shepard?
Where were you when this occurred? What did you see?
Well, not everyone responds to fear rationally. I didn't think Anoleis-sama was this tightly wound.
So you just heard it.
Still, I have to wonder why you didn't try to intervene.
That would make sense if this were a "crime of passion," something done without thinking.
He panicked. Called her in. Shot wildly. Yes. Makes sense. He was always paranoid.
Excuse me, Commander. The death of an executive must always be filed in triplicate.
So you didn't actually witness anything.
Gianna was investigating Anoleis' corruption. She worked for the Executive Board.
Beats me. I just got here myself.
I told Anoleis that Gianna was Internal Affairs. I thought it would pressure him into helping me.
I was out by Gianna's desk. I didn't see any of it.
There wasn't enough time.
I only heard an argument and shots fired.
Gianna was Internal Affairs.
[Lie] I don't know.
I told Anoleis about Gianna.
I was outside.
I heard yelling.
It happened too fast.
And I should not be telling you how to do your job. My apologies.
My job isn't arresting criminals. It's shooting terrorists.
Not my job.
Anoleis asked Gianna to see him in his office. Then there were gunshots.
Anoleis called Gianna in.
By the time I got in the door, it was already over.
If I could have, I would.
